title: Integration Restart and Reload Counter
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeassistant:event (event_type=integration_reloaded OR message="*setup failed*")
| stats count as reloads, sum(eval(match(message,"failed"))) as failed_setups by integration
| where reloads>0
| sort - reloads
description: Counts how often each Home Assistant integration reloads or fails to start, exposing the flaky ones that need attention or replacement.
value: A frequently reloading integration is a slow-motion outage; counting reloads points you at the unstable add-ons dragging the whole hub down.
implementation: Forward integration setup/reload events; schedule daily and review the least stable integrations.
visualization: Table of integrations by reload and failed-setup count.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how often each smart-home add-on has to restart, so you can spot the unreliable ones.
